title: Data Center Devs Struggle with Conflicting Desires: Speed to Power and ‘Five 9s’

meta.summary:
Data center developers and financiers express the desire for near constant availability from their facilities using terms that may not be as well known to the electricity industry: “three” or “five 9s.” 
 The post  Data Center Devs Struggle with Conflicting Desires: Speed to Power and ‘Five 9s’  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
